data.description:
## Description
**What**: Publish plugins/dso/docs/contracts/negative-example-comment.md defining the NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment schema (schema_version=1, bug_type_slug, intent_ids_if_applicable, missed_signal_summary, what_test_would_have_caught_it, generalizable_lesson, related_files, scope_claim, falsification), plus prompt-engineering guidance for sonnet extraction to avoid inverted-polarity drafts, plus a style guide for opus graduation-rule drafting matching the existing 7-rule standard structure.
**Why**: This contract is the walking-skeleton foundation — every downstream extraction (SC2), retrieval (SC3), and graduation (SC5) reads from it. Inverted-polarity guidance is the load-bearing mitigation for the SC2 missed_signal_summary risk.
**Scope**:
- IN: contract markdown file; field-by-field schema; canonical correct-polarity missed_signal_summary example; vacuous-field examples for scope_claim/falsification; opus graduation-rule style guide section.
- OUT: the extraction logic itself (draft-2); the lookup script (draft-3); any agent prompt edits.

## Done Definitions

- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/negative-example-comment.md exists and documents every NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE field named in SC1 (schema_version, bug_type_slug, intent_ids_if_applicable, missed_signal_summary, what_test_would_have_caught_it, generalizable_lesson, related_files, scope_claim, falsification) ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The contract includes a canonical missed_signal_summary example demonstrating correct polarity (describing what FAILED to be detected) ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The contract includes prompt-engineering guidance directing sonnet extraction away from inverted-polarity drafts, plus a consistent style guide for opus drafting of graduation rules ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The contract includes an opus graduation-rule style guide section whose 4-field structure (rule_statement, rationale, anti_pattern_example, correct_pattern_example) matches the existing behavioral-testing-standard.md 7-rule structure ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A schema-conformance test validates that a sample NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE JSON matching the contract parses and a sample with a missing required field is rejected, and unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Dependency] intent_ids_if_applicable values reference 94ed-f55c manifest entries; the contract must state values MUST reference real manifest entries OR be empty. External blocker: 94ed manifest vocabulary — do not redefine it here.
- [Dependency] bug_type_slug values derive from the 4911-c7ba taxonomy; the contract references that taxonomy as the source of slugs rather than enumerating slugs inline.
- [Risk] Inverted-polarity guidance is the primary spec-level mitigation for missed_signal_summary; the canonical example must be unambiguous.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a published NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment contract, so that extraction and graduation agents share one authoritative schema with correct-polarity guidance.
